what: Amneal makes generic medicines and a growing range of specialty and injectable products, including biosimilars, sold mostly in the United States, and it also distributes medicines.
customers: Pharmacy chains, wholesalers, hospitals and the government.
money: distribution to government and institutional buyers
moat: Approved manufacturing facilities and a broad generic portfolio, plus specialty products with patent protection that generics cannot copy.
risks: Generic prices fall continuously as competitors enter each molecule
53 times earnings on a 2.4% net margin
opportunities: Revenue grew from $2.1B to $3.0B in four years
Analysts see about 14% upside, with 7 covering the stock
Biosimilars and injectables carry higher margins than oral generics and are a growing share
watch: Specialty and biosimilar revenue growth, and debt reduction.
